interpretation: Diversity ratio 0.89: generated samples are about as varied as real samples in pixel space.
Median NN distance generated->train (0.111) vs real->other-train (0.088): no sign of copying; samples are new combinations rather than near-duplicates.
notes: Pixel RMSE is a crude proxy: it ignores perceptual similarity and small shifts.
Diversity ratio near 1 means generated samples are as spread out as real ones; much lower suggests mode collapse.
Generated->train NN distances far below real->train NN distances would suggest memorisation.
FID was not computed: it needs an ImageNet Inception network and thousands of samples, and is unreliable for 64x64 pixel art with ~3.6k training images.
